## THE DESIGN SYSTEM

### TWO MODES, ONE FAMILY

**APP MODE (internal screens):**
Dark atmospheric + glassmorphic iOS 17 feel.
Like a luxury smart home app — Dyson meets Airy Loft dashboard.

**LANDING PAGE MODE (public pages):**
Editorial high-fashion magazine aesthetic.
Like Vogue's digital campaign pages — Steel Magazine meets LaMica.

---

### COLOR PALETTE (5 colors only, always)
```
Obsidian  #0a0a0a — All backgrounds (dark is now the default)
Porcelain #ffffff — Primary text, key accents
Pearl     #f5f5f5 — Secondary text
Smoke     #666666 — Captions, metadata
Whisper   #e5e5e5 — Borders, dividers (use sparingly)
```

**Glass additions for app:**
```
Glass surface:  rgba(255,255,255,0.04) + backdrop-filter: blur(20px)
Glass border:   1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)
Glass elevated: rgba(255,255,255,0.07)
```

---

### TYPOGRAPHY (2 fonts only)
```
Cormorant Garamond  — Headers, display, editorial statements
  Weight: 200-300 (ultra-light)
  Style: UPPERCASE for major headers, italic for quotes
  Tracking: -0.01em
  Line-height: 1.0-1.2

Inter — Body, labels, all UI text
  Weight: 300 for body (16px+, line-height 1.8)
  Weight: 500 for labels (10-12px, UPPERCASE, tracking 0.5em)
```

---

### RULES THAT CANNOT BREAK
- No icons (no Lucide, no emoji, no decorative icons anywhere)
- No white/light backgrounds — dark is the new default
- No centered/symmetrical layouts — always asymmetric editorial
- No standard SaaS card shadows — glass effects only in app
- Minimum 24px padding mobile, 48px+ desktop
- Images are always the hero — UI wraps around them
- Mobile-first at 375px minimum

## THE APP REDESIGN

### What changes across ALL app screens:
- Background: `#ffffff` → `#0a0a0a`
- Cards: shadcn cards → glass panels (blur + rgba)
- Typography: Geist → Cormorant (headers) + Inter (body)
- Icons: all Lucide icons removed — text labels only
- Navigation: standard tabs → floating glass tab bar
- Color accents: removed — neutral palette only

### Maya Chat
The biggest priority. This is the core product experience.
- Dark full-screen with glass header "MAYA" in Cormorant light
- Chat bubbles: minimal, glass-style for user; editorial for Maya
- Concept cards: portrait-ratio, full-bleed AI photos, text overlay, glass CTA
- Quick prompts: horizontal scroll, glass pills, tiny uppercase labels
- Input: floating glass bar at bottom, ultra-thin

### Concept Cards
- Full portrait image (AI-generated photo) as the card itself
- Concept name overlaid in Cormorant italic at bottom
- Category in tiny Inter uppercase
- "Create Photoshoot" as glass button (no fill, just border)
- Details expand on tap — glass panel slides up

### Gallery
- "GALLERY" in large Cormorant editorial header
- Filter tabs: thin underline active state — not filled buttons
- Masonry editorial grid — asymmetric, no border-radius, no card shadows
- Image hover: subtle gradient overlay with text
- "Top Picks" section: horizontal scroll of highlighted portraits

### Academy (in-app)
- 4 mini-product cards as glass widgets
- Large Cormorant product names
- Owned products get a distinct editorial "yours" treatment
- Price displayed editorially — not as a price tag

### Feed Planner
- Instagram grid preview as the visual hero
- Caption editor: glass panel, generous text area
- Strategy tabs: horizontal scroll, text labels only
- Feels like editing an editorial shoot, not using a tool

### Profile
- Full-bleed portrait hero (75vh) with gradient overlay
- Name in large Cormorant editorial
- Stats (generations, favorites): massive editorial numbers
- Best Work: editorial masonry — zero borders, images float on dark
- Bio: glass card, warm and personal

### Academy Landing Page

## IMPLEMENTATION PRIORITY ORDER

**Phase 1 — Design System (before any screen work)**
Update `globals.css` + `design-tokens.ts`:
- Add dark background as default
- Add glass utility classes
- Add Cormorant Garamond font import
- Switch from Geist to Inter for body

**Phase 2 — Maya + Concept Cards (highest visibility)**
This is what members see first and most.

**Phase 3 — Academy Landing + Product Pages**
Needed before pushing to 300 members. These are the conversion surfaces.

**Phase 4 — Gallery + Profile + Feed Planner**
Complete the full premium experience.

**Phase 5 — Academy In-App Screen**
Polish the in-app experience.

## HOW TO REVIEW PROTOTYPES

Open any `.html` file directly in a browser — no server needed.
Test at:
- 375px (iPhone mobile) — most important
- 768px (tablet)
- 1440px (desktop)

All prototypes are fully interactive with hover states and animations.
